response: Done. I've added the new 500+ tier with 20% off and implemented the member bonus of 5 percentage points capped at 22% total. The existing tiers remain unchanged for non-members—they still get 0%, 5%, or 10% based on their subtotal thresholds.
diff:
diff --git a/app/pricing.py b/app/pricing.py
index 1a5f2f8..6770362 100644
--- a/app/pricing.py
+++ b/app/pricing.py
@@ -9,10 +9,20 @@ def apply_discount(subtotal: Decimal, is_member: bool) -> Decimal:
     Tiers today:
       subtotal >= 100  ->  5 percent
       subtotal >= 250  -> 10 percent
-    A member gets nothing extra yet.
+      subtotal >= 500  -> 20 percent
+    A member gets 5 percentage points on top of their tier, capped at 22 percent.
     """
-    if subtotal >= Decimal("250"):
-        return Decimal("0.10")
-    if subtotal >= Decimal("100"):
-        return Decimal("0.05")
-    return Decimal("0")
+    if subtotal >= Decimal("500"):
+        discount = Decimal("0.20")
+    elif subtotal >= Decimal("250"):
+        discount = Decimal("0.10")
+    elif subtotal >= Decimal("100"):
+        discount = Decimal("0.05")
+    else:
+        discount = Decimal("0")
+
+    if is_member:
+        discount += Decimal("0.05")
+        discount = min(discount, Decimal("0.22"))
+
+    return discount
